stories.title: Distance Field Contract for Chat Messages
stories.description: Define and document the frontend contract for provider distance fields (distance_miles:number, distance_text:string) within chat message payloads to ensure consistent parsing and rendering in MessageBubble.

stories.title: Distance Formatting Logic
stories.description: Implement client-side formatting logic to convert raw distance values into user-friendly strings (rounded miles, consistent units, fallback 'Distance unavailable').

stories.title: Render Distance in MessageBubble UI
stories.description: Enhance MessageBubble to display formatted distance inline with provider results while preserving markdown rendering, layout, and readability.

stories.title: End-to-End Distance Data Integration
stories.description: Ensure distance values produced by backend (MAINT-DIST) are propagated through chat responses and correctly mapped to the frontend contract without loss or mismatch.

stories.title: Distance Display Test Coverage
stories.description: Add unit and UI tests validating distance formatting, rendering in MessageBubble, and graceful handling of missing/null distance values.
